q: Fill the gap: I need ___ umbrella. Which answer is correct?
Use 'an' before a vowel sound, 'a' before a consonant sound, 'the' for something specific.
She ___ it two days ago (to steal). Which form completes the sentence?
With two days ago we use the past simple: stole.
What is the superlative form of 'bad'?
They ___ never (to send) that. Which form completes the sentence correctly?
The present perfect is have/has + past participle (sent).
He said, 'I will come tomorrow.' Which sentence reports this correctly?
He said that he will come tomorrow.
He said that I would come tomorrow.
He said that he would came the next day.
He said that he would come the next day.
In reported speech the tense moves back and time/place words change.
